verdict.rationale: Apple's first-party pages say you can copy images, video, or text on an iPhone or iPad and paste it into an app on a nearby Mac, or the reverse (docs-5). The Mac User Guide also lists copy and paste between devices as a feature (docs-21). Both sources are brief marketing-level claims. Missing for 10: detailed docs on setup and requirements (pairing, same account, proximity), explicit evidence for Mac-to-Mac clipboard sharing, independent or hands-on corroboration.
